definitions.explanation: A disposable plate made of paper or card, used for picnics, parties and food stalls. The さ of {皿|さら} becomes ざ in the compound.

examples.japanese: {紙皿|かみざら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紙皿|かみざら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{盛|も}った→盛る：00292_moru⟧。
examples.english: I served the fried noodles on a paper plate.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誕生日会|たんじょうびかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{洗|あら}い{物|もの}→洗い物：08171_araimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紙皿|かみざら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: At the children's birthday party we use paper plates to cut down on washing up.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ (paper) and ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧ (plate), with the usual voicing of the second part.

- {紙皿|かみざら}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{紙|かみ}コップ→紙コップ：33940_kamikoppu⟧: paper plates and cups
